FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probes: scratch/s473t3/probes/p25-tr.pl,
p26-charname.pl.

ROW BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 1 row):
  tr.t 257 `tr// of \N{name} works for upper-Latin1`
  -- perl-tests/tr.t:1112-1114 ([perl #128734])
  ...but the gap is much wider than that row, which is why it is filed as a
  feature task and not a tr/// task.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    my $s = "\N{LATIN SMALL LETTER A WITH ACUTE}";
    printf "string-literal = U+%04X\n", ord($s);
    my $t = "x"; $t =~ s/x/\N{LATIN SMALL LETTER A WITH ACUTE}/;
    printf "s///-repl      = U+%04X\n", ord($t);
    my $u = "\N{U+00E1}";
    printf "U+ literal     = U+%04X\n", ord($u);
    my $v = "abc";
    print "regex-match    = ", ($v =~ /\N{LATIN SMALL LETTER A}/ ? 1 : 0), "\n";
    my $w = chr 0x00e1; $w =~ tr/\N{LATIN SMALL LETTER A WITH ACUTE}/A/;
    printf "tr///          = U+%04X\n", ord($w);
  perl: U+00E1 | U+00E1 | U+00E1 | 1 | U+0041
  PCL : U+004E | U+004E | U+00E1 | 0 | U+00E1
  So `\N{U+XXXX}` (the numeric form) WORKS; the NAMED form silently loses the
  backslash and leaves a literal `N` -- in a string literal that is a wrong
  CHARACTER in the program's data, with no warning.

MECHANISM: nothing resolves a Unicode character NAME.  SBCL ships the table:
`sb-unicode:name-char` is the one-call implementation (project memory,
"Unicode: `\N{NAME}` -> shim `sb-unicode:name-char`").  Fix area: the escape
decoder shared by string interpolation, the regex translator and `do-tr`
(CLAUDE.md rule 11 -- ONE decoder, not one per consumer).

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md tr.t, "Test 257: `tr// of
\N{name}` for upper-Latin1 - named char escape in tr."

FAMILY: Unicode; the parked item in project memory
([[project_next_unicode_property_regex]]).  NOT `docs/not-supported.md`:
there is no entry for `\N{NAME}`, and a wrong character with no diagnostic is
CLAUDE.md rule 12's sin whether or not the feature is ever implemented.
subject: SILENT WRONG (Unicode): the `\N{NAME}` named-character escape is not implemented -- `"\N{LATIN SMALL LETTER A WITH ACUTE}"` is U+00E1 in perl and the single character `N` (U+004E) in PCL, in string literals, `s///` replacements, regexes and `tr///` alike
